The zone types that may become a drawable unit, best first

Source: R/app_bundle.R
APP_UNIT_TYPES.Rd

Master-plan D17 (Ben, 2026-09-22): a release publishes at most one drawable unit — Program Areas, or Planning Areas on v1, which has no Program Areas. Never subregions, never ecoregions, whatever the data would support: those are camera presets and scoring context, not places a user draws a report for. Their scores stay in boot$zones untouched.

Usage

APP_UNIT_TYPES

Value

a character vector of zone types, in preference order

Details

First match wins, so a later decision is one line here rather than a rewrite of app_units().

Examples

APP_UNIT_TYPES
#> [1] "programarea" "planarea"
